Counsel for Applicant :- Bhagwati Prasad Nigam,Ajeet Kumar Singh,Anurag Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the informant is the wife of one Deepak Sharma and the applicant used to harass her and when she told this fact to her husband, her husband tried to counsel him then he was also threatened.

No allegation of rape was leveled in the FIR, subsequently in the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she stated that she was carrying love affair with the applicant for the last two years and on the false pretext of marriage, the applicant had formed physical relations with her and she was married to one Deepak on 30.01.2023.
On the one hand, no allegation of rape was leveled against the applicant in the F.I.R., however in the Chandbabu Alias Sameer Alias Manjesh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Home Lko.

1 statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. allegation was leveled that on the false pretext of marriage, physical relations were formed with the applicant.
Admittedly, the informant is a married lady.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

4. Prima facie, the aforesaid statements of the victim do not appear to be trustworthy coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 11.06.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

( b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
